description: Synthetic benchmark corpus for the Northwind Cloud Backup Service. Covers factual lookup, table lookup, ordered procedures, exceptions/warnings and multi-part questions across six document formats. All content is synthetic and contains no private or copyrighted material.

relevance_scale.2: highly relevant: passage contains the primary fact for the question
relevance_scale.1: relevant: passage comes from an expected source and contains an essential fact

relevance_rule: A retrieved chunk is graded 2 if its source_name is in expected_sources and its text contains the primary_fact; graded 1 if its source_name is in expected_sources and its text contains any essential fact; otherwise 0.

questions.question: What encryption standard does Northwind use for data at rest?
questions.reference_answer: Northwind encrypts data at rest with AES-256.
questions.notes: Direct factual lookup within the Security and Encryption section.

questions.question: Which transport protocol secures data in transit?
questions.reference_answer: Data in transit is secured with TLS 1.3.
questions.notes: Same section as q01; tests that the right fact is retrieved.

questions.question: What is the monthly price of the Enterprise plan?
questions.reference_answer: The Enterprise plan costs $49 per month.
questions.notes: Requires the table row to be retrieved with its header.

questions.question: How long is the retention window on the Standard plan?
questions.reference_answer: The Standard plan retains backups for 90 days.
questions.notes: Table lookup for retention.

questions.question: At what time do the default backups run?
questions.reference_answer: Backups run at 02:00 UTC; the full backup runs every Sunday and an incremental backup runs daily.
questions.notes: Fact spread across the Backup Schedule paragraph.

questions.question: What is the maximum single file size on the Enterprise plan?

evidence.section: What is the maximum file size?

questions.reference_answer: The Enterprise per-file limit is 500 GB.
questions.notes: Related concept present in two documents; either is acceptable evidence.

questions.question: Which plan cannot be used for database backups?

questions.reference_answer: The Basic plan cannot be used for database backups.
questions.notes: Exception handling: answer lives in the Warnings and Exceptions list.

questions.question: What does error code E-101 mean?
essential_facts: could not reach the Northwind cloud endpoint
questions.primary_fact: could not reach the Northwind cloud endpoint
questions.reference_answer: E-101 means the agent could not reach the Northwind cloud endpoint.
questions.notes: Plain-text error code lookup.

questions.question: What causes error E-204 and how is it fixed?
questions.reference_answer: E-204 is an authentication failure caused by an expired account token; regenerate the token and update the agent.
questions.notes: Cause-and-fix lookup.

questions.question: Which network port must be open when resolving sync failures?
questions.reference_answer: Outbound port 443 must be open.
questions.notes: Answer is one step inside an ordered procedure.

questions.question: What must you avoid doing when restoring a database snapshot?
essential_facts: Do not restore a database snapshot while the database service is running
questions.primary_fact: Do not restore a database snapshot while the database service is running
questions.reference_answer: Do not restore a database snapshot while the database service is running; stop the service first.
questions.notes: Exception phrasing must be preserved by the chunker.

questions.primary_fact: Native agents are available for Windows, macOS and Linux
questions.reference_answer: Yes, native agents are available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
